install.installedDesc: RastaHale Academy is already installed on your device. You can open it from your home screen.
install.title: Install App
install.tapToInstall: Tap to install straight onto your device
install.android1Desc: Go to rastahale.simplix.digital in Chrome or your Android's default browser.
install.android2Desc: Tap the menu icon (⋮) in the top right corner of the browser.
install.android3Desc: Pick "Add to home screen" or "Install app" from the menu.
install.android4Desc: Tap "Add" in the confirmation window. The app icon will show up on your home screen.
install.ios1Desc: Go to rastahale.simplix.digital. Installing only works in Safari — not in Chrome or other browsers on iPhone.
install.ios2Desc: Tap the share icon (□ with an up arrow) in Safari's bottom bar.
install.ios3Desc: Scroll the list of options and tap "Add to Home Screen" (the icon with a +).
install.ios4Desc: Tap "Add" in the top right corner. The app will show up on your home screen as a native icon.
install.tipDesc: In Chrome an install banner may pop up automatically at the bottom of the screen. Tap it to install even faster!
install.whySafariDesc: Apple restricts PWA installation to Safari. Open the link in Safari and follow the steps above.
